recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. Any future cleanup of dormant legacy spreadsheets should first confirm those files are still intended build inputs; this reconciliation intentionally stayed limited to active fhir.ini profile sources.
issue_request: FHIR-5983 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and requested that spreadsheets expose only the four binding-strength choices rather than combining Conformance with a separate Extensible boolean column.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied by git commit 986a9f2b89d4299a8dd76b9acfae0ad3b65c2cab, imported from svn revision 5450, titled '#5983 - clean up binding strength in spreadsheets'. That commit removed the obsolete Extensible column from many then-current spreadsheets.
additional_context: The current active [profiles] entries in source/fhir.ini include source/profiles/pharmacy-extensions-spreadsheet.xml, source/profiles/element-extensions-spreadsheet.xml, and source/profiles/rendering-extensions-spreadsheet.xml, which were introduced later by the FHIR-14270 profile-directory move and still carried the stale Extensible header. A 2020 Zulip spreadsheet-authoring discussion confirmed that 'extensible' belongs as a Conformance value and the separate Extensible column should be removed. Other Extensible headers found in source/request, source/devicedispense, source/entrydefinition, and source/iteminstance were not edited because they were not active fhir.ini build inputs.
reconciliation: Changed the three active profile extension spreadsheets to remove the Extensible column from the Binding sheet, update the filter range and expanded column count from 14 to 13, update the trailing column index, and drop the corresponding empty cells from blank rows. No binding data rows or value set semantics changed because these Binding sheets were empty apart from headers/formatting rows.
source_changes: source/profiles/pharmacy-extensions-spreadsheet.xml: removed the obsolete Extensible Binding-sheet column and adjusted the sheet metadata/blank cells to a 13-column layout.
source/profiles/element-extensions-spreadsheet.xml: removed the obsolete Extensible Binding-sheet column and adjusted the sheet metadata/blank cells to a 13-column layout.
source/profiles/rendering-extensions-spreadsheet.xml: removed the obsolete Extensible Binding-sheet column and adjusted the sheet metadata/blank cells to a 13-column layout.
